papers.title: Elliptical Attention
papers.findings: Eq7 diagonal Mahalanobis metric from coordinatewise function variability; selected robustness statements and neighboring-layer value difference estimator. Generic contextual metric adaptation is prior art.
papers.gaps: Appendixproofs/completeempiricaltables/code notread; no verification of all theoreticalassumptions.

papers.title: Data-Adaptive Mahalanobis Metric Learning for Cross-Head Attention in Transformers
papers.findings: Sec3 input-dependent full crosshead metric ftheta(X), row-summed into perhead quadratic scores followed bysoftmax. Inputdependentmetric alone is not new.
papers.gaps: Venue claimNeurIPS2026 appearsinPDF butnot independentlyverified. Appendix/code/resultsnotread; no complete theoreticalcorrectness or noveltyclearance.
